name: amfx-gme-microstructure-research
description: amFX reproduction (13JUN25 p3): GameStop (GME) 1-minute chart showing an unusual microstructure anomaly on Jun 12, 2025. A massive resting bid at $21.54 absorbed all selling for hours, creating a perfectly flat horizontal line. Described as 'one of the weirdest 1-minute charts I have seen in a while.' Shows the sharp decline from ~$24 to $21.54, the extended flat line, then late-day activity. Source: amFX 13JUN25 newsletter (Brent Donnelly, Spectra Markets).
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: GAMESTOP 1-MINUTE MICROSTRUCTURE ANOMALY
# =============================================================================
# Reproduces page 3 chart from amFX 13JUN25 newsletter.
# GME 1-minute chart for Jun 12, 2025 showing massive resting bid
# at $21.54 that created a perfectly flat line for hours.
# Sharp selloff from ~$24+ to $21.54, then flat, then bounce/break.
# 'One of the weirdest 1-minute charts I have seen in a while.'
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
idx = index()

xy_lines(
    title='GameStop 1-Minute: The $21.54 Resting Bid Anomaly',
    category='GME Microstructure',
    y_axis_label='Price (USD)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='GME Close', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=21.54, title='$21.54 Massive Bid', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid),
        ReferenceLine(value=22.00, title='$22.00', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=23.00, title='$23.00', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=idx, y_values=close)
